page: Microsoft Azure F4ads_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Fadsv7 server family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The server features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 472 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

Benchmark results show top-tier single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core scoring 3757.98 and Geekbench single-core reaching 2840.0. Single-threaded tasks such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also perform in the top 10% tier. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core, falls within the average tier. Memory bandwidth is moderate, with read-only large block bandwidth measured at 53.01 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at 34.32 GB/sec. For LLM workloads, text generation using a small 135M model is highly efficient, though prompt processing for medium 7B models is relatively weak.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the F4ads_v7 offers a balanced resource density, combining dedicated high-frequency AMD EPYC cores with fast local NVMe SSD storage. This makes it a viable option for workloads requiring a mix of compute power and low-latency local storage without the overhead of larger memory footprints. The server is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, single-threaded processing tasks, lightweight database operations, static web serving, and small-scale text generation or processing applications.
